description:
1. Daily Operations
* Support the sales team in managing contracts and communication with the factory when needed.
* Assist the Sales Manager in updating weekly reports and preparing customer contracts.
2. Reporting System
* Compare data from the Sales and Accounting departments on a monthly basis.
* Update the payment term list of new customers and revise payment terms for existing customers to the Accounting team.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and efficient processing of data for monthly sales reports.
3. Other Duties
* Perform additional tasks as assigned by the Sales Manager.
